Peanut Butter & Chocolate Chips Cookies
By: Ambreen
Published: Thursday, June 30, 2011 - 5:25am

Ingredients




100 gms butter, softened
60 gm peanut butter
80 gm castor sugar
110 gm plain flour
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1/2 cup chocolate chips/ raisins

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 175 C. 2 Beat butter and peanut butter. 3 Add sugar and beat until light and fluffy. 4 Sift together plain flour and baking soda. 5 Mix in the butter mixture to form a dough. 6 Add chocolate chips / raisins, mix well. 7 Roll tablespoon of mixture into balls and place 2" apart on a cookie sheet. 8 Slightly flatten balls with a fork. 9 Bake for 12-14 minutes or until golden around edges. 10 Remove from oven,leave for 2 minutes on the cookie sheet. 11 Then transfer to wire rack to cool completely. 12 Store in an airtight container.

About


Chocolate & peanut butter is one of the best combinations. These cookies are family favorites ... just melts in your mouth.
